# flipFISH

Performs barcode-decoding quality control for FISH-based spatial
transcriptomic runs.

It’s been known since the introduction of MERFISH that long barcodes,
i.e., those more than twenty bits, can be expected to have around half
of spots decoded as the wrong mRNA species [(Moffitt and Zhuang
2016)](https://doi.org/10.1016/bs.mie.2016.03.020).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`dichot.guass.benchmark()`](https://oviedolab.org/flipFISH/reference/dichot.guass.benchmark.md)
  :

  Benchmark `misread.qc` function with dichotomized-Gaussian simulations

- [`misread.qc()`](https://oviedolab.org/flipFISH/reference/misread.qc.md)
  : Run misread QC analysis on summary stats data from spatial
  transcriptomics experiment

- [`plot.PPV()`](https://oviedolab.org/flipFISH/reference/plot-PPV.md) :

  Plot estimated PPV by barcode from `misread.qc` results

- [`plot.counts()`](https://oviedolab.org/flipFISH/reference/plot-counts.md)
  :

  Plot predicted vs observed counts from `misread.qc` results

- [`plot.fr()`](https://oviedolab.org/flipFISH/reference/plot-fr.md) :

  Plot estimated flip rates from `misread.qc` results
